senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) arm; (with animals) fore-leg, shoulder; strength, force.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17b:16">Ber. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ניזונין בז׳</he> receive their sustenance from the Lord by dint of their strength (virtue), opp. <he>בצדקה</he> by divine grace.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> top <he>זְרוֹעָן של כל ישראל</he> the arm (defence, protection) of all Israel.
<cite ref="Shabbat 56a:16">Sabb. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>נטלו בז׳</he> they took by force.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:12">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> <he>כבא על חבירו בז׳</he> like one coming against his neighbor with force (confident of victory).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 10:1">Ḥull. X, 1</cite> <he>הז׳</he> the law concerning the shoulder as the priest’s share (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:3">Deut. XVIII, 3</cite>). Ib. 98ᵃ <he>ז׳ בשלה</he>, v. <cite ref="B01361"><he>בָּשֵׁל</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְרוֹעוֹת</he>, constr. <he>זְרוֹעֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Sotah 49b:16">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:3">Tosef. ib. XIV, 3</cite> <he>ז׳ תורה</he> the supports of the Law.—<he>בעלי ז׳</he> violent men.
